name: io.github.zyvorai/netra
title: Netra
description: eBPF network observability and safe emergency control for Linux and Kubernetes.

environmentVariables.name: NETRA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Netra controller API, e.g. https://netra.example:30870.

environmentVariables.name: NETRA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token for the controller API.

environmentVariables.name: NETRA_MCP_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to expose the opt-in mutating tools. Off by default; mutations remain plan-token and lease bounded.

environmentVariables.name: NETRA_MCP_ACTOR
environmentVariables.description: Actor name recorded in the Netra audit trail for calls made through this server.
